title: From Caricature to Collective Artifact: How Persona Construction Drives Polarization in Generative Social Simulations
reasoning: The paper focuses on political polarization, affective polarization, and the effects of persona construction in generative social simulations using LLMs. While religion is briefly mentioned as a demographic variable extracted from survey data to build personas, the study does not focus on, evaluate, or benchmark religious topics, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
